Flow.description: Tracks time spent in each Case status on the Case_Status_History_Tracker__c object. On Case creation a tracker record is created with the entry time for the initial status. On every status change the duration for the previous status is accumulated (existing hours + hours elapsed since entry) and the entry time for the new status is stamped. Duration fields store total accumulated hours across multiple visits to the same status.
Flow.label: Case Status Duration Tracker
